headline: PIT @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 3.90 at ATL 5.26, with a projected total of 9.16. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: PIT moved +0.32 runs while ATL moved +0.94, changing the projected margin by -0.61 runs. The projected total climbed +1.26, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Bryce Elder has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nick Gonzales, Michael Harris II, Ronald Acuña Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Eli White, Jhostynxon Garcia because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
